items.q: until one day we were rehearsing with another version of that group called Composition, with Richard Dunbar on . . .

ctx.x: You were talking about how you met Charles Tyler and you came to do Eastern Man Alone.

He’s on the record with Charles Tyler and I. We did that. Charles remained my student, even though I had some serious doubts about what he was doing, until one day we were rehearsing with another version of that group called Composition, with Richard Dunbar on . . .
